summary: Show the birds heard by BirdNET-Go on your Mac or Linux computer.
page_description: A quiet offline viewer for bird collages detected and rendered on your own computer.
release_notes: Open the latest host-pushed bird collage, see when it was updated, and keep the last complete snapshot offline.

steps.text: Run BirdNET-Go and Fugleramme on a Mac or Linux computer with a microphone.
Start the companion through the existing owner-attended SSH path.

user: Somebody who runs BirdNET-Go on a home computer and wants its bird collages on their Kobo.
job: Open the latest pushed bird collage, see when it was updated, and keep the last complete snapshot offline.
offline: A collage already on the reader stays viewable with no network; only fetching a new one needs the companion.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; the original collage stays on the computer that rendered it

non_goals: It does not detect birds itself; detection happens on the computer running BirdNET-Go.
It does not stream live audio or show a live view.
